directive: **Repos** — decide and link the repositories: emit `<repo_link owner/repo>` for each (clones it into the hub + records the link in plan.db, durable). Do NOT write repos.json — links live in plan.db (`bsc-plan repo list` shows them; `bsc-plan repo add owner/repo` links one directly).
name: Repos
blurb: Link the repositories this project spans.
prompt:
Link the repositories this project spans. For each, emit `<repo_link owner/repo>` — that clones it
into the project hub and records the link in the project's **plan DB** (durable). Note each repo's
default branch and its role in the system. Do NOT write repos.json — the link lives in plan.db
(`bsc-plan repo list` shows the linked set; `bsc-plan repo add owner/repo` links one directly).

Gate: at least one repository is linked.
